map.Nginx 常用于托管静态站点或反向代理后端。选择场景并填参数，本工具生成标准: Nginx is commonly used to host static sites or reverse proxy a backend. Pick a scenario, fill in the parameters, and this tool generates a standard server block you can copy into your site config.
map.按场景生成 Nginx server 配置。: Generate an Nginx server configuration for your scenario.
map.：静态站点、反向代理、HTTPS、负载均衡、单页应用（SPA）回退。: : static site, reverse proxy, HTTPS, load balancing, and single-page application (SPA) fallback.
map.：listen 端口、server_name、root/index、locati: : listen port, server_name, root/index, and location matching rules and precedence.
map.：ssl_certificate、ssl_certificate_key，并限制: : ssl_certificate and ssl_certificate_key, plus restrictions on protocol versions and cipher suites.
map.：需设置 proxy_set_header 传递真实客户端 IP，否则后端日志全: : set proxy_set_header to pass the real client IP, otherwise your backend logs will be full of the proxy address.
map.监听端口必须是 1–65535 的整数。: Listen port must be an integer from 1 to 65535.
map.反向代理模式必须填写上游地址（如 http://127.0.0.1:8080）。: Reverse proxy mode requires an upstream address (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080).
map.上游地址必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。: The upstream address must start with http:// or https://.
map.静态根目录不能为空。: The static root directory cannot be empty.
map.静态根目录必须以 / 开头。: The static root directory must start with /.
map.HTTPS 场景必须填写 SSL 证书路径。: HTTPS mode requires an SSL certificate path.
map.HTTPS 场景必须填写 SSL 私钥路径。: HTTPS mode requires an SSL private key path.
map.反向代理的 proxy_pass 末尾是否带 / 影响路径拼接：带 / 会剥离: For a reverse proxy, whether proxy_pass ends with / affects path joining: a trailing slash strips the location prefix, so choose accordingly.
map.配置改完用 nginx -t 校验语法，再 nginx -s reload 生效: After editing the config, validate the syntax with nginx -t and then apply it with nginx -s reload, so that a mistake does not take the service down.
map.生产应补 TLS（listen 443 ssl）、gzip、缓存头等；本工具只生: For production you should also add TLS (listen 443 ssl), gzip, cache headers and more; this tool only generates a minimal working skeleton.
map.可视化生成 server/location 配置。: Generate server and location configuration visually.
map.新站点上线前生成配置：填域名、端口与后端地址得到可用的 server 块，再按需: Generate config before launching a new site: enter the domain, port and backend address to get a working server block, then add HTTPS and security headers as needed.
map.填域名+端口+根目录 → 输出 server 块。: Enter domain + port + root → outputs a server block.
map.生成后怎么用？: How do I use the generated config?
map.放入 conf.d 并 `nginx -t` 校验后 reload。: Drop it into conf.d, validate with `nginx -t`, then reload.
map.生成后还要补什么？: What else should I add after generating?
map.至少三件事：一是 HTTPS（证书路径、HTTP/2，以及 80 端口跳转）；二: At least three things. First, HTTPS (certificate paths, HTTP/2, and a redirect from port 80). Second, security headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and CSP depending on your needs). Third, upload size and timeouts (client_max_body_size, proxy_read_timeout), since the defaults often do not suit real workloads. Always validate with nginx -t before going live.
map.按模式取值：域名为空时用下划线占位，站点根目录或上游地址为空时用默认路径，端口取: Resolve values by mode: use an underscore placeholder when the domain is empty, default paths when the web root or upstream is empty, and floor the port input (falling back to 80 when invalid). Static mode generates a server block with listen port, server name, root, default index, and a location that tries the request path, then the path as a directory, otherwise returns 404; reverse-proxy mode generates a server block with listen port, server name, and a location forwarding to the given upstream while setting the forwarded host and real client address. The whole config is HTML-escaped and shown in a code block
map.新站点上线前生成配置：填域名、端口与后端地址得到可用的 server 块；需要: Before launching a new site, generate a working server block from the domain, port and backend address; when TLS is needed, choose HTTPS static site and fill in the certificate/key paths, then add HTTP/2, 80→443 redirect and security headers as needed.
map.至少三件事：一是 HTTPS 的收尾（本工具可生成证书与私钥路径，仍需自行补 H: At least three things: finish HTTPS (this tool can generate certificate and key paths, but you still add HTTP/2 and the 80→443 redirect yourself); security headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, CSP as appropriate); and upload size and timeouts (client_max_body_size, proxy_read_timeout), whose defaults often do not fit real workloads. Always run nginx -t before going live.
